## 2. Structural Systems & Building Series Overview

### 2.1 Q-Series: True Arch (Quonset Geometry)
- **Structural Profile**: Continuous semicircular self-supporting cold-formed arch.
- **Clear Span Range**: 9.0 meters to 45.0 meters (30 ft to 148 ft) with zero internal columns or trusses.
- **Centerline Ridge Height**: 4.5 meters to 18.0 meters.
- **Panel Metallurgy**: Galvalume Plus® AZ180 (ASTM A792 / EN 10346), 55% Aluminum, 43.4% Zinc, 1.6% Silicon alloy coating.
- **Yield Strength**: 345 MPa to 550 MPa (50 ksi to 80 ksi) depending on site load calculation.
- **Wind Velocity Resistance**: Standard design for 180 km/h; custom-engineered up to 240 km/h (Category 5 hurricane threshold).
- **Ground Snow Load**: Up to 3.5 kN/m² (approx. 350 kg/m²).
- **Key Applications**: Aircraft and helicopter hangars, bulk agricultural grain silos, fertilizer and salt storage, mining heap-leach covers, heavy machinery storage.
- **Erection Methodology**: Pre-curved corrugated steel panels are bolted together on the ground in arches, then hoisted into position and anchored into foundation grade beams with 8.8 grade anchor bolts.

### 2.2 S-Series: Straight-Sidewall Arch Roof
- **Structural Profile**: Vertical straight side walls (height 2.5m to 5.0m) merging into an arched self-supporting roof crown.
- **Clear Span Range**: 12.0 meters to 30.0 meters (40 ft to 100 ft).
- **Centerline Ridge Height**: 5.0 meters to 12.0 meters.
- **Advantage Over True Arch**: Straight vertical walls allow perimeter installation of multi-tier pallet racking systems and unrestricted forklift travel right up to wall edges.
- **Key Applications**: Logistics distribution warehouses, light industrial manufacturing facilities, commercial workshops, vehicle maintenance depots.

### 2.3 P-Series: Pitched Gabled Arch
- **Structural Profile**: Straight vertical walls with a gabled pitched roofline.
- **Clear Span Range**: 10.0 meters to 24.0 meters (33 ft to 80 ft).
- **Centerline Ridge Height**: 4.0 meters to 9.0 meters.
- **Key Applications**: Commercial garages, agricultural workshops, municipal equipment depots, retail storage.

### 2.4 Container Canopy Truss Systems
- **Structural Profile**: Arched structural steel truss frames mounted on standard ISO shipping containers (single or double stacked, 20ft or 40ft).
- **Clear Span Range**: 8.0 meters to 20.0 meters (26 ft to 66 ft).
- **Anchoring**: Heavy-duty container twist-lock and clamp mounting systems requiring no permanent foundation excavation.
- **Key Applications**: Rapid-deployment exploration mining camps, jobsite equipment dry zones, military field logistics, port interim storage.

### 2.5 Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB Portal Frames)
- **Structural Profile**: Tapered built-up I-section solid web frames with rigid knee and ridge moment connections.
- **Clear Span Range**: Up to 60.0 meters unobstructed.
- **Crane Integration**: Overhead bridge crane capacities up to 50 Metric Tons with dedicated crane corbels and runway beams.
- **Key Applications**: Heavy industrial plants, automotive manufacturing, logistics sorting mega-hubs.

---

## 3. Metallurgy & Corrosion Performance: Galvalume Plus® AZ180

### 3.1 Chemical Composition & Galvanic Mechanism
- **55% Aluminum**: Provides a microscopic passivating barrier layer of aluminum oxide that prevents atmospheric oxidization.
- **43.4% Zinc**: Provides sacrificial cathodic protection. If cut, sheared, or drilled, zinc corrodes preferentially to protect exposed core steel edges.
- **1.6% Silicon**: Added to the hot-dip bath to ensure uniform micro-crystalline adhesion between steel substrate and coating layer.
- **Coating Mass**: AZ180 (180 grams per square meter total both sides), ASTM A792 / A792M standard.

### 3.2 Lifespan & Thermal Efficiency
- **Lifespan**: 40 to 50 years maintenance-free service life under severe industrial, agricultural ammonia, and coastal marine environments.
- **Solar Reflectance**: High thermal emissivity and solar reflectance index (SRI > 75) repelling up to 80% of incident solar thermal radiation, lowering cooling HVAC energy demands by up to 35%.

---

## 4. International Regulatory Compliance & Design Codes

### 4.1 European Standards (CE Marking)
- **EN 1090-2:2018 Execution Class 4 (EXC4)**: Highest tier of structural steel execution control, verified through non-destructive testing (NDT), ultrasonic inspection, and calibrated torque bolting.
- **Eurocode 1 (EN 1991)**: Actions on structures (wind pressures per EN 1991-1-4 and snow load accumulation per EN 1991-1-3).
- **Eurocode 3 (EN 1993)**: Design of steel structures (EN 1993-1-1 general rules and EN 1993-1-3 cold-formed members).

### 4.2 North American Standards
- **AISC 360-16**: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings (American Institute of Steel Construction).
- **AISI S100**: North American Specification for the Design of Cold-Formed Steel Structural Members.
- **AWS D1.1**: Structural Welding Code (used exclusively during factory automated sub-assembly; 0% field welding).

### 4.3 Quality & Safety Management
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management Systems.
- **ISO 14001:2015**: Environmental Management Systems.
- **ISO 45001:2018**: Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems.

---

## 5. Logistics & Flat-Pack Containerization Economics

### 5.1 Container Stuffing Metrics
- **Shipping Unit**: 40ft High-Cube (40HC) Ocean Container.
- **Internal Volume**: 76.4 m³ (2,700 cu ft).
- **Payload Capacity**: Up to 28,500 kg (62,800 lbs).
- **Floor Area per Container**: Approximately 350 m² to 400 m² of complete building kit (including arch panels, structural bolts, neoprene sealing washers, and base channels).
- **Example**: A 1,200 m² grain storage hangar requires only three 40HC containers, resulting in up to 70% freight cost savings compared to bulky pre-welded lattice trusses.

### 5.2 Maritime Transit Corridors from Mersin Port
- **Southern Europe & Mediterranean**: 3 to 7 days transit.
- **North Africa & Red Sea**: 5 to 10 days transit.
- **Arabian Gulf (Jebel Ali, Dammam, Doha)**: 12 to 18 days transit.
- **West Africa & East Coast USA**: 18 to 28 days transit.

## 6. Commercial Procurement & 24-Hour RFQ Protocol

### 6.1 Engineering Review Requirements
To receive an official stamped engineering quotation, submit:
1. **Desired Clear Span (Width)**: Inside usable dimension (m or ft).
2. **Total Building Length**: Bay spacing increments (typically 0.61m / 2ft arch module).
3. **Eave and Apex Clearances**: Height requirements for machinery, aircraft tails, or stacking height.
4. **Site Coordinates / Destination Port**: For exact calculation of statutory wind and seismic codes and ocean freight rates.

### 6.2 Turnaround Time & Deliverables
- **Turnaround**: Maximum 24 hours.
- **Deliverables**:
  - Preliminary static feasibility calculation.
  - Complete Bill of Materials (BOM).
  - 3D container packing and stowage simulation.
  - Official commercial proposal under Incoterms 2020 (FOB Mersin Port or CIF Destination Seaport).
